about: THE DELTA CAUSEWAY (route R11, One World phase 4.3, 2026-11-17): a dirt road from Giza's east side (row 32) to Göbekli Tepe's west side (row 31), two plots across the reed flats. The old secret robbers' tunnel `gobekli_giza` between the two (row 30) stays as it is: it is the tunnel, this is the road over the top. The road crosses on the line between rows 31 and 32, bends up a little and goes in at Göbekli's south-west corner plot; the plots south of it (19..20 x 32..33) are open flats off the road. Places (ow-places.js, ideas): the reed bed on the flats the page names. Bake: node bake-desert.js, node bake-leylines.js, then node bake-route.js R11.
